question: Ros-chi, Crusch-sama (1), Crusch-sama (2), Priscilla, Felt, Leip Barielle, Heinkel Astrea. What’s the order of the ones with the best popularity with their people?
answer: Priscilla, Crusch-sama (1), Roswaal, Felt, Crusch-sama (2), Heinkel, Leip. (note: Crusch-sama (1)’s name used a kanji for the -sama, while (2) used hiragana. I’d guess that (1) is Crusch before the events at the end of arc 3, and (2) is Crusch after.)
